leaf.name: DNA Length Problem
leaf.description: Uncondensed DNA is extremely long and would tangle or break if the cell tried to pull it apart.

DNA Length Problem.question:
**Quiz Question:**

Explain why uncondensed DNA poses a problem for a cell during processes like cell division, and describe what could happen if the cell attempted to pull uncondensed DNA apart.

leaf.name: Compact Chromosomes
leaf.description: Condensed chromosomes are compact, allowing them to be handled without damage.

leaf.name: Spindle Fiber Attachment
leaf.description: Compact chromosomes can attach to spindle fibers and be moved cleanly.

leaf.name: Sister Chromatid Separation
leaf.description: Sister chromatids separate evenly during anaphase.

leaf.name: Accurate Inheritance
leaf.description: Each daughter cell gets one complete, accurate copy of every chromosome.
